name: Immortality Incremental
creator: Immortality Incremental
redeem: Launch Immortality Incremental and wait for your character to load in.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Scroll down inside the Shop until you reach the Codes section.
Type or paste the code into the Input Code Here! box and click Use.
notes:
Immortality Incremental is a cultivation-themed incremental game published by the Immortality Incremental group in January 2026. You click, or let the built-in autoclicker work, to build power, then break through into higher cultivation realms. Reset layers let you give up progress in exchange for permanent multipliers, and Marks add extra enhancements on top. The game has since expanded into multiple worlds, dungeons, and crafting.

Codes typically give potions, Tickets, and Jade, which speed up breakthroughs and let you push further before each reset. The developers add new codes with most world updates and at visit milestones, and post them in the game's Discord community server as well as the description.

faq.q: Where do I enter codes in Immortality Incremental?
faq.a: Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen and scroll down to the Codes section. Type the code into the Input Code Here! box and click Use.

faq.q: Where does the Immortality Incremental developer post codes?
faq.a: The game description tells players to join the community server to redeem secret codes. Some codes, like RELEASE, are also listed in the description itself. New codes usually arrive with world updates and visit milestones.

faq.q: What do Immortality Incremental codes usually give?
faq.a: Codes usually give potions (such as Path, Mark, Weather and Ore potions), Tickets and Jade. These speed up breakthroughs and let you get further before each reset.

tips: Leave the built-in autoclicker running so your power keeps climbing on its own. That frees you to focus on when to break through to the next realm.
Before you use a reset layer, read what boost it gives. A reset only pays off if the multiplier makes your next run faster than staying where you are.
Like and favorite the game and join the group. The description says these unlock follower rewards and extra boosts, which are easy gains for a new player.
The game now has several worlds and a dungeon. Build up your breakthroughs and multipliers in the early world first, because harder areas are slow without them.
useRewards: RELEASE gives a set of free potions. The game has several kinds, such as Path, Mark, Weather and Ore potions, so read what each one does before drinking it. Potions that boost progress are best used right after a reset, when you are about to climb quickly through the early realms. If a later code gives Tickets or Jade, hold them until you know what they unlock in the world you are working on.
